children.author: DaSHacka
children.text:
Hm, so individuals still have no hope of getting offensive security capabilities from U.S. labs?

I haven't even bothered doing CVP; if it'll just refuse my prompts anyway, might as well keep my information private.

At least the chinese models will happily chug along at whatever task I give them, and they're cheaper too!

children.author: hxugufjfjf
children.text: We’re just getting denied from CVP time and time again by a robot with no explanation as to why. No human support exists at Anthropic so no way to appeal properly.
